definitions.explanation: The powdery residue left after burning.

examples.japanese: {紙|かみ}が{燃|も}えて{灰|はい}になった。
examples.english: The paper burned and turned to ash.

examples.japanese: たばこの{灰|はい}を{灰皿|はいざら}に{落|お}とした。
examples.english: I tapped the cigarette ash into the ashtray.

examples.japanese: {火山|かざん}が{噴火|ふんか}して、{町|まち}に{火山灰|かざんばい}が{降|ふ}り{積|つ}もった。
examples.english: The volcano erupted, and volcanic ash piled up on the town.
examples.notes: {火山灰|かざんばい} uses the reading ばい for {灰|はい}.

examples.japanese: キャンプで{焚|た}き{火|び}をした{後|あと}、{残|のこ}った{灰|はい}をきちんと{片付|かたづ}けてから{帰|かえ}るようにしている。
examples.english: After having a campfire, I make sure to clean up the leftover ashes properly before heading home.

notes:
{灰|はい} refers to the powdery residue left after burning.

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
- {灰|はい}を{捨|す}てる: to dispose of ashes
- {灰|はい}になる: to turn to ash, to be destroyed
- {灰|はい}にする: to reduce to ashes

COMPOUNDS:
- {灰皿|はいざら}: ashtray
- {灰色|はいいろ}: gray (ash color)
- {火山灰|かざんばい}: volcanic ash
- {石灰|せっかい}: lime (calcium oxide)
- {遺灰|いはい}: cremated remains, ashes

KANJI NOTE:
The reading changes in compounds: {灰|はい} alone, but often {~灰|~ばい} in compounds (e.g., {火山灰|かざんばい}).
